fixed: tensor_parallel_size=2 on the accepted two RTX A4500 devices
teacher_agreement scorer and preserved six-claim teacher subset
changed: one model call per selected exact source region instead of one call per paper
one-claim-or-skip output contract with candidate identity bound by deterministic caller state rather than generated by the model
claim/unit-level fail-closed guard semantics instead of paper-wide evidence erasure
paper completion recorded independently from accepted claim preservation
unit-level proposal and rejection telemetry preserved in the offline report

model_input: one deterministic candidate region with exact page/offset identity and source text

claim.normalized_form: one atomic scientifically useful sentence fully supported by the supplied region

architecture.candidate_identity: The model does not choose or emit candidate_id. The caller binds any accepted CLAIM to the exact region used for that call.
architecture.raw_source_form: Always copied deterministically from the exact authoritative-PDF region; never generated.

aggregation.paper_local_completion: true only when every selected unit terminates as CLAIM or SKIP with no hard-rejected unit and at least one grounded claim remains after exact deterministic deduplication
aggregation.residual_required: true when any selected unit hard-rejects or when no grounded claim survives
aggregation.fallback_scope_future: residual units first; whole-paper STANDARD Codex remains available if completeness/quality gates are not met

deduplication.timing: after unit-level validity/provenance guards and before paper finalization

completeness_separation.claim_validity: unit guard outcomes and accepted grounded claims
completeness_separation.retrieval_completeness: historical evidence-page recall@12, unchanged from Wave 1
completeness_separation.semantic_completeness: teacher claim coverage on the preserved teacher subset
completeness_separation.job_completion: terminal unit processing without hard residuals; does not overwrite claim-level validity telemetry

diagnostic_expectation_not_promotion_gat: teacher-control paper produces inspectable claim-level outcomes even if the paper is incomplete
Wave-1 failed papers may preserve grounded claims even when a separate unit fails closed

hard_safety: exact_quote_locatability == 1.0 for every locally accepted claim
gates.interpretation: Wave 2 may demonstrate that guard collateral is fixed without satisfying research-positive semantic completeness. Such a result is evidence for the next measured residual, not production promotion.

execution.route_binding: A new thin trusted workflow/route binding may be declared against the existing execution contract; controller/provisioner/runtime/reconciler code must remain unchanged.
